basic_profile.bio: Brendan is a 34-year-old software engineer based in Turin, Italy. With a deep-seated passion for Pokémon and a knack for coding, he often spends his evenings trading Pokémon from his extensive collection. When he's not immersed in the world of Pokémon, Brendan enjoys listening to true crime podcasts and exploring Italian history. A self-proclaimed tech enthusiast, he also dabbles in WiFi network setups and troubleshooting. Brendan is single and enjoys spending his free time in online communities. His typical online hours are from 7 PM to midnight local time, after work and personal pursuits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Brendan holds a computer science degree, which he obtained from a local university in Italy. His expertise in Pokémon breeding stems from years of dedicated gameplay and active participation in niche Pokémon communities. His technical skills are further bolstered by his professional experience as a software engineer, where he specializes in backend systems and network security.
